status: Five concept proposals; no runtime boss or hazard implementation

concepts.title: Background Hunger
concepts.description: A huge head emerges from the wall shadows, commits to one lane, then lunges over intact track. Direct-hit consequences remain undecided.

concepts.title: Track-Eating Bite
concepts.description: An early bite removes track ahead, leaving a persistent pit and waterfalls. The opposite bank remains open; a lane and edge warning must persist when the new hole is offscreen.
concepts.revision: Game-compatible sprite-style study; giant head-wide opening mouth, headright/playerleft. Not runtime art.

concepts.title: Maintenance Hand
concepts.description: Optional giant hand reaches from a background hatch, strikes a marked center area, then withdraws to reveal a small pit. Impact rules and inclusion remain unapproved.
concepts.status: Proof of concept authorized; full-bank jump-required destruction under team design

concepts.title: Wall-Driven Ram
concepts.description: Optional wall-mounted pressure ram strikes one bank and retracts, leaving damaged support. The visible mechanism establishes where the hazard comes from.

concepts.title: Ceiling Strainer Drop
concepts.description: Optional heavy strainer hangs from visible chains, drops onto a warned bank zone, and is hoisted away from the broken floor.

reference.features: Bald crown, sparse side hair, broad face, full light brown/graying beard and moustache, brow/nose/cheek proportions.
reference.source: User supplied photo at 2026-10-26 16:15; used only for boss face concepts.

mechanics_proposals.jaw_lane: Far230..345 or near315..430; never entire channel or115-deep centered footprint.
mechanics_proposals.head_hitbox: Large illustrative head silhouette is not collision bounds. Only declared jaw contact plane is dangerous.
mechanics_proposals.track_bite: Open ahead of player, not immediate pit under a hero who just took damage. Keep edge/lane pointer when offscreen.
mechanics_proposals.persistent_damage: Broken support stays visibly broken with matching pit/rim/waterfall.
mechanics_proposals.refuge: One committed attack at a time; no simultaneous obstruction of designated safe lane.

open_decisions: Direct bite/hand impact damage versus fatality
Final timing and geometry after playable testing
limitations: Generated plates are illustrative, not registered runtime screenshots or collision diagrams.
Some hero poses and board designs vary from existing game sprites; these are scale references only.
Maintenance Hand lower panel labels near/far beside left/right arrows; do not use those labels as a bank-axis diagram. Canonical bank axis is screen y.
Track-bite plate shows outcome, not exact required ahead-of-player timing or offscreen cue placement.

user_direction.boss: Head right, player left; head-wide Pac-Man-like mouth opening almost larger than closed head. Plan only.
user_direction.hand: Implement proof of concept currentLevel2; destroys track and requires jumping.
user_direction.ram_camera: Engineering feasibility consultation; no camera implementation yet.
user_direction.strainer: Explore holes spanning one or two of three bank lanes; dodge or jump.

archival_status_note.note: Original proposal statuses retained as creation-time history. Maintenance Hand implemented110; strainers implemented112 and revised114. Boss and wall ram remain proposals.
